title: Diamond Brass Band and the minstrel show Ducongé
summary: He knows nothing of the Diamond band; he knows Oscar Ducongé, who played anything.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Instead. Could you ask me if you ever heard of the diamond brass band in Al Jays?
You ever heard of the diamond brass band in Al Jays? They're from Al Jays.
No. Ask him, did he ever hear of it?
Tell him I found it in the newspaper.
You find it out in the newspaper. He can root up some dirt.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Did you ask me if you ever heard of Jackson, Lee, Irving, and Ducanger's minstrels?
Did you ever hear of Jackson, Lee, and Ducanger's instruments? What kind of instruments? Minstrels. Minstrels. They played minstrels shows, you know? Jackson, Lee, and Ducanger.
But you know, you never did hear him play the minstrels shows, huh?
I don't remember. Ask him which Ducanger's do you know?
There's how many of you. Which one of the Ducanger's do you know?
He played slide. He played all the things.
